overview.en: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking is the thinker variant of Qwen3-Omni: a native end-to-end omni-modal Mixture-of-Experts model with 30.5B total parameters and 3.3B activated per token. It accepts text, images, audio, and video, produces text output, and exposes chain-of-thought reasoning. This recipe covers the three single-node scenarios from the upstream tutorial: high throughput (TP2), low latency (TP4 with expert parallelism), and long context (TP4 with 131072 tokens and YaRN). All validated scenarios use the public official BF16 checkpoint and require no local weight conversion.
overview.zh: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking 是 Qwen3-Omni 的 thinker 版本：原生端到端全模态 MoE 模型，总参 30.5B、每 token 激活 3.3B。它支持文本、图像、音频、视频输入，输出文本并带思维链推理。本 recipe 覆盖上游教程的三个单节点场景：高吞吐（TP2）、低时延（TP4 + 专家并行）与 131072 tokens 长上下文（TP4 + YaRN）。所有验证场景均使用公开的官方 BF16 权重，无需本地转换权重。

weight_download[1].weight_version.zh: W8A8（使用 msmodelslim 本地量化）

quantization.content.en:
No public W8A8 checkpoint is published for this model; the validated W8A8 weights were produced from the official BF16 checkpoint with **msmodelslim**. The quantized checkpoint keeps the following hybrid layout:

- **Embedding layer**: BF16 (not quantized)
- **Q/K normalization** (`q_norm`, `k_norm`): BF16
- **Attention projections** (`q/k/v/o_proj`): static W8A8 with per-tensor scales; biases remain BF16
- **MoE routing gate** (`mlp.gate`): BF16
- **MoE expert projections** (`gate/up/down_proj`): dynamic W8A8

Follow the [Quantization Guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/user_guide/feature_guide/quantization.html) and keep the generated directory layout unchanged so that `--quantization ascend` can load it.
quantization.content.zh:
该模型没有公开的 W8A8 权重，本 recipe 验证的 W8A8 权重由官方 BF16 权重经 **msmodelslim** 量化得到，保持以下混合布局：

- **Embedding 层**：BF16，不量化
- **Q/K 归一化**（`q_norm`、`k_norm`）：BF16
- **Attention 投影**（`q/k/v/o_proj`）：静态 W8A8，per-tensor scale，bias 保持 BF16
- **MoE 路由 gate**（`mlp.gate`）：BF16
- **MoE 专家投影**（`gate/up/down_proj`）：动态 W8A8

请按[量化指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/user_guide/feature_guide/quantization.html)操作，并保持生成目录结构不变，以便 `--quantization ascend` 加载。

env_setup.container.A3.content.en:
Use the official vLLM-Ascend all-in-one image validated for this recipe.

**Docker Pull:**

```bash
docker pull quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0-a3-openeuler
```

**Docker Run:**

```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0-a3-openeuler

docker run \
    --name vllm-ascend-env \
    --shm-size=128g \
    --net=host \
    --privileged=true \
    --device /dev/davinci0 \
    --device /dev/davinci1 \
    --device /dev/davinci2 \
    --device /dev/davinci3 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager \
    --device /dev/devmm_svm \
    --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -v /models:/models \
    -it -d $IMAGE bash
```

> **Note**: Atlas 800I A3 has 8 NPUs with a dual-die design (16 chips). This recipe uses at most 4 chips (`/dev/davinci0` to `/dev/davinci3`). Add more device mounts to expose the remaining chips.

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
Two-chip tensor-parallel deployment (TP2) maximizes aggregate throughput for many concurrent requests while keeping the official BF16 weights resident across two chips.

```bash
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

vllm serve your_model_path \
    --served-model-name qwen3-omni \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-num-seqs {{max_num_seqs}} \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}} \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
    --distributed_executor_backend "mp" \
    {{prefix_caching}} \
    {{async_scheduling}} \
    {{compilation_config}} \
    --additional-config '{"enable_flashcomm1": false}' \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    --port 8000 \
    {{spec_decoding}}
```

> - No `--quantization` flag is needed: the official BF16 checkpoint is loaded as floating-point weights.
> - Prefix caching is disabled in the validated configuration.
> - Omni multimodal inputs are processed by the same OpenAI-compatible endpoint; no extra server flag is needed.

```bash
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
    --distributed_executor_backend "mp" \
    {{prefix_caching}} \
    {{async_scheduling}} \
    {{compilation_config}} \
    --additional-config '{"enable_flashcomm1": false}' \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    --port 8000 \

```

scenarios[0].steps[1].content.en:
```bash
curl http://localhost:<port>/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "model": "qwen3-omni",
        "messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "Reply with exactly one word: OK"}
        ],
        "temperature": 0,
        "max_tokens": 64
    }'
```

Expected result: HTTP 200 with a non-empty `choices` array.

For multimodal input, send an `image_url`, `input_audio`, or `video_url` content part in the same message. A validated example combined one image, one audio clip, and one video clip in a single request and received a coherent description.

Four-chip tensor parallelism with expert parallelism reduces per-token latency. FlashComm1 is disabled for this model, matching the upstream tutorial.

```bash

export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

vllm serve your_model_path \
    --served-model-name qwen3-omni \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-num-seqs {{max_num_seqs}} \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}} \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --distributed_executor_backend "mp" \
```

scenarios[2].steps[0].content.en:
The long-context scenario keeps TP4 with expert parallelism, raises the context limit to 131072 tokens with YaRN, and lowers `--max-num-seqs` to 14. vLLM-Ascend v0.30.0 validates `max_position_embeddings` strictly, so `VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1` is required when the requested length exceeds the checkpoint value.

```bash
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1

vllm serve your_model_path \
    --served-model-name qwen3-omni \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-num-seqs 14 \
    --max-model-len 131072 \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --distributed_executor_backend "mp" \
    {{prefix_caching}} \
    {{async_scheduling}} \
    {{compilation_config}} \
    --additional-config '{"enable_flashcomm1": false}' \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    --port 8000 \
    --hf-overrides '{"rope_parameters": {"rope_type": "yarn", "factor": 2, "original_max_position_embeddings": 65536}}' \
    {{spec_decoding}}
```

> - `VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1` is needed because the checkpoint declares 65536 positions while the scenario requests 131072.
> - Reduce `--max-num-seqs` further if the KV cache approaches the NPU memory limit.
scenarios[2].steps[0].content.zh:
长上下文场景保持 TP4 与专家并行，通过 YaRN 将上下文提升到 131072 tokens，并把 `--max-num-seqs` 降到 14。vLLM-Ascend v0.30.0 会严格校验 `max_position_embeddings`，当请求长度超过 checkpoint 声明值时需要设置 `VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1`。

```bash
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1

vllm serve your_model_path \
    --served-model-name qwen3-omni \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-num-seqs 14 \
    --max-model-len 131072 \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --distributed_executor_backend "mp" \
    {{prefix_caching}} \
    {{async_scheduling}} \
    {{compilation_config}} \
    --additional-config '{"enable_flashcomm1": false}' \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    --port 8000 \
    --hf-overrides '{"rope_parameters": {"rope_type": "yarn", "factor": 2, "original_max_position_embeddings": 65536}}' \
    {{spec_decoding}}
```

> - checkpoint 声明 65536 个位置，而场景请求 131072，因此需要 `VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1`。
> - KV Cache 接近 NPU 显存上限时，可继续降低 `--max-num-seqs`。

evaluation.accuracy.content.en:
### Using EvalScope

EvalScope supports OpenAI-compatible endpoints and the OmniBench dataset:

```bash
python3 -m venv /root/eval-venv
/root/eval-venv/bin/pip install -U "numpy>=2.0" evalscope
/root/eval-venv/bin/evalscope eval \
    --model qwen3-omni \
    --api-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 \
    --api-key EMPTY \
    --eval-type openai_api \
    --datasets omni_bench gsm8k bbh \
    --dataset-args '{"omni_bench": {"extra_params": {"use_image": true, "use_audio": false}}}' \
    --limit 100 \
    --eval-batch-size 4 \
    --generation-config '{"max_tokens": 10000, "temperature": 0.6}'
```

**Accuracy results (Atlas 800I A3, vLLM-Ascend v0.30.0, W8A8, 100 samples per dataset):**

| Dataset | Metric | Score |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OmniBench (image) | accuracy | 49.00% |
| GSM8K | accuracy | 99.00% |
| BBH | accuracy | not completed |

The two completed datasets match the upstream tutorial reference (v0.22.1rc, W8A8):
OmniBench 0.44 and GSM8K 0.98. BBH was not completed because EvalScope expands
--limit 100 to 100 samples per BBH subtask (2700 total), which exceeded the
validation time budget; the tutorial reference is 0.9148.

performance.benchmark.en:
### Measured Results

All numbers below were collected on one Atlas 800I A3 node (16 chips available; at most 4 used) with `quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0-a3-openeuler`.

| Scenario | TP | Requests | Concurrency | Output tok/s | Mean TTFT (ms) | Mean TPOT (ms) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| High Throughput | 2 | 200/200 | 32 | 960.72 | 293.05 | 30.60 |
| Low Latency | 4 | 200/200 | 1 QPS | 126.89 | 168.74 | 15.92 |
| Long Context | 4 | 20/20 | 4 | 201.30 | 864.92 | 16.54 |

Benchmark shapes: 200 input / 512 output tokens at concurrency 32 for high throughput; 200 input / 128 output tokens at 1 request per second for low latency; 8192 input / 256 output tokens at concurrency 4 for long context, plus a 70,025-token functional request. All numbers use the official BF16 checkpoint.

### Scenario Overview

| Scenario | Deployment Mode | Total NPUs | Weight Version | Key Considerations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| High Throughput | Single-Node (TP2) | 2 (A3) | BF16 | Two-chip TP keeps the official weights resident while maximizing concurrent request processing |
| Low Latency | Single-Node (TP4) | 2 (A3) | BF16 | Multi-chip TP with expert parallelism reduces per-token latency |
| Long Context | Single-Node (TP4) | 2 (A3) | BF16 | Fewer concurrent sequences leave room for a 131072-token context |

> On Atlas 800I A3 each NPU contains two dies (chips), so TP4 uses 4 chips = 2 NPUs.
performance.benchmark.zh:
### 实测结果

以下数据均在单台 Atlas 800I A3（共 16 芯片，最多使用 4 芯片）与 `quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0-a3-openeuler` 镜像上采集。

| 场景 | TP | 请求数 | 并发 | 输出吞吐（tok/s） | 平均 TTFT（ms） | 平均 TPOT（ms） |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 高吞吐 | 2 | 200/200 | 32 | 960.72 | 293.05 | 30.60 |
| 低时延 | 4 | 200/200 | 1 QPS | 126.89 | 168.74 | 15.92 |
| 长上下文 | 4 | 20/20 | 4 | 201.30 | 864.92 | 16.54 |

基准形状：高吞吐为 200 输入 / 512 输出、并发 32；低时延为 200 输入 / 128 输出、每秒 1 请求；长上下文为 8192 输入 / 256 输出、并发 4，并额外用 70025 tokens 单请求做功能验证。以上数据均使用官方 BF16 权重。

### 场景概览

| 场景 | 部署方式 | NPU 总数 | 权重版本 | 关键考量 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 高吞吐 | 单节点（TP2） | 2（A3） | BF16 | 两芯片 TP 保持官方权重常驻，并最大化并发请求处理能力 |
| 低时延 | 单节点（TP4） | 2（A3） | BF16 | 多芯片 TP + 专家并行降低单 token 时延 |
| 长上下文 | 单节点（TP4） | 2（A3） | BF16 | 降低并发序列数为 131072 tokens 上下文预留空间 |

> Atlas 800I A3 每个 NPU 包含两个 die（芯片），因此 TP4 使用 4 个芯片，即 2 个 NPU。

tuning.en:
### Tuning Guidelines

- Increase `--max-num-seqs` for throughput until NPU memory or the scheduler becomes the bottleneck.
- Decrease `--max-num-seqs` and `--max-model-len` when multimodal requests time out.
- Prefix caching is disabled in the validated scenarios; enable it for workloads with repeated media or prompt prefixes and measure the hit rate first.
- Refer to the [Performance Tuning Guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/developer_guide/performance_and_debug/optimization_and_tuning.html) for additional options.
tuning.zh:
### 调优建议

- 逐步提高 `--max-num-seqs` 直到 NPU 显存或调度成为瓶颈。
- 全模态请求超时时，降低 `--max-num-seqs` 与 `--max-model-len`。
- 验证场景关闭前缀缓存；对于重复媒体或提示前缀的业务，可开启并先评估命中率。
- 更多选项见[性能调优文档](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/developer_guide/performance_and_debug/optimization_and_tuning.html)。

faq.en:
**Why is `VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1` required?** The checkpoint declares 65536 positions. vLLM-Ascend v0.30.0 refuses to start with a larger `--max-model-len` unless this variable is set. The long-context scenario uses it together with the YaRN overrides.

**Is a public W8A8 checkpoint available?** No. Quantize the official BF16 checkpoint with msmodelslim; the resulting directory can be loaded with `--quantization ascend`. W8A8 is an optional path for memory-constrained deployments and is not part of the CI-verified scenarios.

**Which precision does CI verify?** BF16. All three scenarios load the public official BF16 checkpoint and need no local weight conversion.

**Is Eagle3 speculative decoding supported?** Yes. The optional draft model is exposed as an off-by-default `spec_decoding` feature and was functionally validated on Atlas 800I A3 at TP1 (4/4 HTTP 200 responses, no ERROR/Traceback in the logs). Replace `your_eagle3_model_path` with the local draft-model directory before enabling it. The performance tables above remain the non-Eagle3 baseline.

**Does the Thinking variant return reasoning content?** Yes. The server returns the reasoning trace in the response message; set `max_tokens` high enough to cover both the reasoning and the final answer.
faq.zh:
**为什么需要 `VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1`？** checkpoint 声明 65536 个位置，vLLM-Ascend v0.30.0 在 `--max-model-len` 更大时会拒绝启动。长上下文场景需同时设置该变量与 YaRN 覆盖项。

**是否有公开的 W8A8 权重？** 没有。请使用 msmodelslim 对官方 BF16 权重量化，生成的目录可直接通过 `--quantization ascend` 加载。W8A8 是面向显存受限部署的可选路径，不属于 CI 验证场景。

**CI 验证哪种精度？** BF16。三个场景均加载公开的官方 BF16 权重，无需本地转换权重。

**是否支持 Eagle3 投机推理？** 支持。可选的草稿模型通过默认关闭的 `spec_decoding` 特性提供，已在 Atlas 800I A3 的 TP1 上完成功能验证（4/4 HTTP 200，日志无 ERROR/Traceback）。启用前请将 `your_eagle3_model_path` 替换为本地草稿模型目录。上方性能表仍为非 Eagle3 基线。

**Thinking 版本会返回推理内容吗？** 会。响应 message 中包含推理轨迹，`max_tokens` 需同时覆盖推理与最终答案。
